lines.text: The younger son asked for his share of the estate, then journeyed to a distant country and squandered his wealth.
After a famine struck, the younger son was sent into the fields to feed goats, longing to eat the pods.
The father ran to his son, embraced him, and told his servants to bring the best robe.
The father ordered the fattened lamb killed, because his son was dead and alive again.
The older son became angry and refused to go in, so his father came out and pleaded with him.
